content:
The long-awaited "Ted Lasso" is set to return, with its fourth season premiering next week on Apple TV+ (watch here). Apple has just released the official trailer.

"Ted Lasso" Season 4 trailer highlights the return of beloved characters alongside a brand-new cast

Next week will mark Apple TV+'s biggest premiere of the year: "Ted Lasso" Season 4 will debut on August 5.

The hit comedy starring Jason Sudeikis is returning more than three years after its last season aired. The new season will shift its focus from the AFC Richmond men's football team to a newly formed women's team, the "Lady Greyhounds".

For a full rundown of the new cast members joining the show, as well as which beloved familiar faces are returning, click here.

The new trailer released today reveals little about the plot, instead featuring music by Mumford & Sons intercut with emotional character moments that evoke nostalgia for Ted.

Below is the official synopsis for Season 4, along with the new trailer:

If you love "Ted Lasso," "Trying" is another heartwarming comedy worth watching on Apple TV+. The show is currently airing its fifth season and holds a 97% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

What do you think of the new "Ted Lasso" trailer? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, and you can also subscribe to other services through Apple One bundle for a discounted rate.
